name: AR_BR_BATCH_GT
description: AR_BR_BATCH_GT is a global temporary table used to store transactions selected for bills receivable creation. The table also keeps track of the bills receivable applications against these transactions.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Payment schedule identifier of a transaction added to a bills receivable batch.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Customer transaction identifier of a transaction added to a bills receivable batch.

columns.name: CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Customer transaction type sequence identifier of a transaction added to a bills receivable batch.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Customer identifier of a transaction added to a bills receivable batch.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Customer site use identifier of a transaction added to a bills receivable batch.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number of a transaction added to a bills receivable batch.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: Due date of a transaction added to a bills receivable batch.

columns.name: AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING
columns.description: Remaining amount due on a transaction added to a bills receivable batch.

columns.name: AMOUNT_ASSIGNED
columns.description: Applied amount of a transaction added to a bills receivable batch.

columns.name: EXCLUDE_FLAG
columns.description: Option to exclude a transaction from bills receivable application.

columns.name: IMMEDIATE_FLAG
columns.description: Option to indicate that a transaction is assigned immediate payment terms.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_FLAG
columns.description: Option to indicate that a bill receivable is already applied to the transaction.
